verified_facts.text: The hotel is steps from IFS Panda, Taikoo Li and Chunxi Road.
verified_facts.excerpt: Conveniently situated steps from IFS Panda, Taikoo Li and Chunxi Road

verified_facts.text: The hotel is a 15-minute drive from Kuanzhai Alley and Jinli Ancient Street.
verified_facts.excerpt: The St. Regis Chengdu is a 15-minute drive from Kuanzhai Alley and Jinli Ancient Street

verified_facts.text: The hotel is a 30-minute drive to the Chengdu Research Base of Giant Panda Breeding.
verified_facts.excerpt: a 30-minute drive to Chengdu Research Base of Giant Panda Breeding

verified_facts.text: All deluxe guest rooms span a minimum of 65 square meters with 3.7-meter ceilings.
verified_facts.excerpt: All deluxe guest rooms span a minimum of 65 sqm with 3.7m lofty ceilings

verified_facts.text: Rooms feature American classic styling.
verified_facts.excerpt: featuring timeless American classic styling paired with versatile functional layouts

verified_facts.text: The hotel has 24-hour butler service.
verified_facts.excerpt: 24-hour butler service free drinks, luggage handling, two daily garment presses per guest

verified_facts.text: The hotel has an indoor heated pool and a seasonal outdoor pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: free access to the fitness centre, indoor heated pool and seasonal outdoor pool

verified_facts.text: Vantage XXVII is an outdoor sky bar on the 27th floor, open seasonally from May to October.
verified_facts.excerpt: Vantage XXVII our outdoor sky bar is alighted on the 27th floor. Seasonal opening (operates from May to October every year)

verified_facts.text: Yan Ting is the hotel's signature Chinese restaurant serving Sichuan and Cantonese cuisine.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our signature Chinese restaurant, Yan Ting, is a true culinary destination in Chengdu where we serve authentic Sichuan and Cantonese cuisine

verified_facts.text: Yun Fu offers four private dining rooms and a bespoke set menu of regional or international cuisine.
verified_facts.excerpt: Yun Fu offers guests four private dining rooms and a bespoke set menu featuring your choice of regional or international cuisine

verified_facts.text: Social is a buffet-style restaurant with an alfresco terrace overlooking the Chinese Estates Plaza.
verified_facts.excerpt: Social, our signature buffet-style family restaurant, serves a combination of regional and international cuisines in a welcoming, casual environment that includes an alfresco terrace overlooking the Chinese Estates Plaza

verified_facts.text: The Drawing Room lobby lounge showcases St. Regis rituals including Champagne sabering.
verified_facts.excerpt: Lobby lounge to showcase signature St. Regis brand rituals: Champagne Sabering, savor St. Regis coffee and explore St. Regis Time.

verified_facts.text: The hotel's take on the Bloody Mary, the Chuan Mary, highlights bold Sichuan flavors with a peppery finish.
verified_facts.excerpt: Discover the Chuan Mary: bold flavors of Sichuan cuisine are highlighted with savory notes and a peppery finish at The St. Regis Chengdu.

verified_facts.text: The Presidential Suite has a 12-meter lap pool, a private terrace and a 29th-floor location with Tianfu Square views.
verified_facts.excerpt: Home to a 12-meter lap pool, palatial living room and private terrace, the Presidential Suite boats an unrivaled 29th floor location underscored by rare city skyline and Tianfu Square views.

verified_facts.text: The Empire Suite is on the 28th floor with nearly panoramic views of the Chengdu business district.
verified_facts.excerpt: our Empire Suite combines elegant décor with nearly panoramic views of the Chengdu business district

verified_facts.text: Rooms and suites have views of Chengdu or Tianfu Square.
verified_facts.excerpt: greets guests with iconic views of Chengdu or Tianfu Square

verified_facts.text: The fitness center, the St. Regis Athletic Club, has Technogym machines plus sauna and steam rooms.
verified_facts.excerpt: It features premier Technogym machines, strength- and core-training areas.

verified_facts.text: In-room dining is available 24 hours a day.
verified_facts.excerpt: The St. Regis Chengdu offers the convenience of in-room dining 24 hours a day.

verified_facts.text: The hotel does not provide an airport shuttle; private car service is available on request.
verified_facts.excerpt: This hotel does not provide shuttle service.

verified_facts.text: Pets are not allowed.
verified_facts.excerpt: No, pets are not allowed at The St. Regis Chengdu.

verified_facts.text: Event space includes the Astor Ballroom and five further function rooms.
verified_facts.excerpt: Guests can explore a specialized experience in our Astor Ballroom and another five function rooms.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is about 19.3 km from Chengdu Shuangliu International Airport.
verified_facts.excerpt: CTU is located approximately 19.3 KM from the hotel.
